title: Malicious code in webhook-easy (npm)
description: The npm package webhook-easy version 1.1.0 contains malicious code that executes arbitrary JavaScript fetched from a remote, attacker-controlled URL. This code decrypts and evaluates the fetched content at runtime, enabling remote code execution. The package also includes shadow dependencies that mimic Node.js core modules, potentially introducing additional malicious behavior. This activity is unrelated to the package's stated purpose and represents a supply chain compromise.
